policy: Paper-first. Displayed results are reported values, not a live leaderboard. Local benchmark and output files support auditing, not silent replacement of paper values.

sources.title: SUREON: A Benchmark and Vision-Language Model for Surgical Reasoning
sources.version: Current author-supplied paper.pdf, 12 PDF pages, updated 2026-10-28

sources.detail: 47 Aug27 qualitative CSVs, each covering 299 non-summarization questions; exact local paths retained outside the public site in docs/run-audit.json

claims.claim: 76,061 training QA pairs, 168 procedure types, 10 specialties; 340 benchmark questions, 69 procedure types, 8 specialties; 335 benchmark clips and 165 source videos
Author names, affiliation numbering, institutional names and countries
Four-stage construction pipeline; six surgeon reviewers; public perception supervision and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct backbone
All overall, video/blind, per-category and reported multimodal-gain model values; summarization separate from pooled accuracy on 299 items
Human 64.9; Gemini 52.2; SUREON-VLM 48.2; GPT-5.1 46.8; SUREON-only 44.1; Public-only 20.7
Public surgical perception results and input conditions
Differences among strongest evaluated models are not statistically significant
Training category distribution and summarization exclusion from blind filtering retained from the previous full paper; benchmark category distribution retained from released data
claims.note: Current 12-page PDF omits supplementary tables; retained category totals agree with current Table 2.

claims.claim: Annotation license and release URLs retained from repository release metadata

discrepancies.issue: Current PDF supplies symmetric ±95% CI margins rather than exact bootstrap endpoints.
discrepancies.handling: Data retain the reported margins; chart whiskers are derived from the reported accuracy ± margin. Older exact endpoints are not reused.

discrepancies.issue: Reported gains can differ by 0.1 points from subtraction of rounded displayed accuracies.
discrepancies.handling: Use Table 3 gain rows for both overall and per-category values, without recomputing from rounded accuracies.

discrepancies.issue: The updated paper references supplementary material not included in its 12 pages.
discrepancies.handling: Retain released-data distribution counts and earlier supplementary pipeline details with explicit provenance; remove obsolete current-paper table and page references.

media.status: Local review assets only; public release requires source-specific rights check
media.processing: Three clips per question type (30 total); exact source intervals, no lecture audio, original aspect ratios preserved. Provenance: docs/gallery-provenance.json.
media.example_explanations: Reference answers only; no generated clinical explanations

limitations.browser_testing: JavaScript and data checks are recorded in the editing session; no browser visual verification has been performed.
limitations.supplementary_material: Current PDF has 12 pages and omits supplementary tables; detailed distributions retain prior release provenance.
